name: vmware-monitor
description: Read-only vSphere monitoring: find what needs attention across vCenter and ESXi, with evidence.
long_description: Runs the published vmware-monitor 2.6.2 MCP server locally. It reads inventory, health, alarms, events and performance from your vCenter or ESXi targets; it does not change infrastructure. Run `vmware-monitor init` once to write the config file and local credentials, then point this extension at that config. Use an account with the vCenter Read-Only role.

config_path.title: vmware-monitor config file
config_path.description: config.yaml written by `vmware-monitor init`. Passwords stay in the .env file next to it.
